title: Transparent Bow
description: Resource pack that makes your bow transparent!
body:
![Transparent Bow](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eb2b111f8f5b94554be74ed661ef6bf7a4be3b99_0.webp)

Makes your bow transparent! Great for minigames like Turf Wars where you need to see incoming arrows.
